summary: 30 units reviewed (verses 1-30). Issues: {'minor': 50, 'error': 2}; 28 units need fixes, 2 ok. No regrouping suggested (units 1-5 and 6-30 follow the printed verse numbers). Tokens, case/number labels and roots are largely sound; the real problems are small unsupported additions or omissions in translations (his/my/me/years/ha/ca), Hindi-English mismatches (virāj 'विशेष', sudhā 'आधार' vs 'abode', salila), a wrong 'why' in the vīryā'ni flags of units 6-9 (Devanagari there also prints ऽनि), and one probable unflagged sandhi typo (unit 28 avasṛṣṭāḥ vadhāya). Remaining doubts: unit 1-5 īḍyaṃ nāma; unit 10 tridiva gender; unit 15 tṛta and missing verb; unit 17 aśastim eṣi; unit 29 salilena vācaḥ/antardadhe. Suggested GLOSSARY additions: sudhā = 'good abode' (Hindi उत्तम निवास); virāj = 'wide ruler' (Hindi दूर तक शासन करने वाला); brahman in 'brahman as armour' stays brahman (ब्रह्म); sahasrāyuḥ = thousand-lived; do not add 'his/my/me/years' absent from the text.
